title: Upload reliability promises
question: What do we promise about uploads? This covers duplicate files and duplicate completion events, partial success in a batch, resuming after network loss or app restart, retry limits, cancellation, and expiry of abandoned uploads.
context: Today a repeated completion event counts twice and can mark a capture complete early (UPLD-REQ-001). Resumable multipart sessions exist in the newer uploader (UPLD-REQ-004). An earlier review recommended that a duplicate event must never stand in for another unique file.
